notes_for_editor: Only the FFLOS register entry and the FireLookout.org list describe this site. The Forest Lookouts Cabell page has a state header and no entries. A WebSearch returned a Tick Ridge tower in Cabwaylingo State Forest, but that tower is in Wayne County, not this site, and was not used. The state tower list PDF (wvenc-f5.wvnet.edu) could not be reached (DNS failure), so staffing or removal history may exist there. No build, staffing or removal date found.
